statement: The kernel HID remove path closes the affected interface, destroys its raw client, drains connect work, unregisters native devices and stops HID hardware; SDL disconnects the joystick on a failed HID read. The inspected paths do not implement one cross-slot atomic receiver-failure coordinator, and physical sibling survival after receiver failures is untested.

applicability.revision: pinned Linux v7.3-rc1 and SDL 6defbc0 consumer source; retail hardware unmeasured
applicability.scope: Steam Controller 2026 Puck receiver consumer behavior; no physical or virtual host test
